_about: Ferran Torres's winner, Spain 1-0 Argentina (after extra time), 2026 World Cup final, MetLife Stadium, 19 July 2026, 106th minute. Pedro Porro crossed, Nico Williams headed it on, Ferran Torres finished past Emiliano Martinez. Sources: Wikipedia '2026 FIFA World Cup final' ('scored from a Nico Williams header'), worldcupranking.com goal report (Porro cross, Williams flick), Reuters caption via Times of Israel. The knock-down is filmed as a lofted ball from Williams met first time (the closest move gamecap has). Kits: Spain red/navy; Argentina home stripes shown as one shirt colour (sky blue), white shorts (2026 home kit per Wikipedia kit box). Keeper colours assumed. Used in al-world-cup-captains.
